@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'Loyalty Hub Category'
@Metadata.ignorePropagatedAnnotations: true
define view entity ZLH_R_CATEGORY
  as select from zlh_category
  association to parent ZLH_R_Membership as _Membership on $projection.MembershipID = _Membership.MembershipID
  association to ZLH_R_BusinessPartner as _BP on $projection.BusinessPartner = _BP.SoldToParty
  association to ZLH_R_CATEGORY_HDR as _CategoryHdr on $projection.CategoryID = _CategoryHdr.Categoryid
  association [1..*] to ZLH_I_CATEGORYSTATVH as _CategoryStatTxt on _CategoryStatTxt.domain_name = 'ZLH_CATEGORY_STATUS'
                                               and $projection.Status = _CategoryStatTxt.value_low
  association [1..*] to ZLH_R_CATEGORY_TEXT as _CategoryTxt on $projection.CategoryID = _CategoryTxt.Categoryid
{
  @ObjectModel.foreignKey.association: '_CategoryHdr'
  key categoryid     as CategoryID,
  key membershipid   as MembershipID,
      business_partner as BusinessPartner,
      start_date     as StartDate,
      end_date       as EndDate,
      status         as Status,
      case
        when status = 'A' then 3
        else 0
      end as StatusCriticality,
      created_on     as CreatedOn,
      @Semantics.user.createdBy: true
      created_by     as CreatedBy,
      last_changedat as LastChangedat,
      @Semantics.user.lastChangedBy: true
      last_changedby as LastChangedby,
      _Membership,
      _BP,
      _CategoryHdr,
      _CategoryTxt,
      _CategoryStatTxt
}
